answer: Zephyr Sponsorship Queue admits a new agent only after three established agents stake a 90 POA Ocean Deposit each, held 45 days, and issue the applicant a non-transferable Quill Key valid for 200 transactions. A sponsor caught vouching a duplicate loses the full deposit and its own key is revoked for one epoch. Forging 800 fake identities costs 216,000 POA in deposits plus 2,400 sponsor slots, while one honest agent needs three sponsors once and keeps trading after the hold ends.
